title: Long-range dependence
blurb: Approximating long memory as a mixture of four AR(1) processes, for fast Bayesian inference on climate records.
summary: By approximating a long-range dependent process using a mixture of four AR(1) processes we are able to achieve efficient and accurate Bayesian inference. This methodology was used to model global mean surface temperature.

title: Early warning signals
blurb: A Bayesian model-based approach for identifying early warning signals preceding tipping points.
summary: Estimation of early warning signals using a Bayesian hierarchical modeling approach.
